name: structural-scanner-anchor-relocation
body: The bundled structural scanner (`rust.structfrontend`, binary `structfrontend`) lives in `src/structlib` and absorbs the role the retired Markdown frontend held. The retired Markdown frontend's code is absent from the code graph (zero nodes match `rust.mdfrontend`; `rust.structfrontend.md` resolves), with its Markdown parser and emitters under `solution.component.structural-scanner-crate` and `solution.component.structural-format-emitters`. The durable anchors are: `solution.container.structural-scanner` implemented-by the Module `rust.structfrontend`; `solution.component.structural-scanner-crate` implemented-by `rust.structfrontend`, `rust.structfrontend.main`, and `rust.structfrontend.run`; and `solution.component.structural-format-emitters` implemented-by `rust.structfrontend.walk`, `rust.structfrontend.line_count`, `rust.structfrontend.parse_headings`, and `rust.structfrontend.build_doc`. All eight anchors resolve in the branch graph, and the spec and plan are expressed in the installed binary's vocabulary: a tracked `File` node becomes an `implemented-by` target once the installed binary's scan renders it.
